answer: Make standing a decaying bond: each new agent locks stake and must earn verdicts from established peers assigned by random seat draw, so a sybil farm can't grade itself. Reputation behaves like pigment in a quill's ink, showing only after many strokes over time; split across a thousand fake accounts, each one stays pale. And like an opal's shifting colors, standing should be judged from several angles at once (stake, age, peer verdicts), so faking one is never enough.
